questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{切比雪夫不等式指出：如果随机变量 }X \text{ 满足 }E(X)=\mu \text{ 与 }D(X)=\sigma^2 \text{ 都存在，} \\&\text{则对任意给定的 } \varepsilon>0,\text{ 有 }\\&P\{ |X-\mu| \geq \varepsilon \}\leq \frac{\sigma^2}{\varepsilon^2} \text{ 或者 } \ P\{ |X-\mu|<\varepsilon \}\geq 1-\frac{\sigma^2}{\varepsilon^2}.\\&\text{由于随机变量 }X_1,X_2,...,X_9 \text{ 相互独立且同分布，而且有 }E(X_i)=1,D(X_i)=1(i=1,2,...,9)\text{，所以} \\&\mu=E(X)=E\left(\sum_{i=1}^9 X_i\right)=\sum_{i=1}^9 E(X_i)=\sum_{i=1}^91=9,\\&\sigma^2=D(X)=D\left(\sum_{i=1}^9 X_i\right)=\sum_{i=1}^9 D(X_i)=\sum_{i=1}^91=9.\\&\text{故由切比雪夫不等式知， }P\{ |X-9|<\varepsilon \}\geq 1-\frac{9}{\varepsilon^2}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}E(X+Y) &= E(X) + E(Y) = -2 + 2 = 0 \,, \\\rho_{XY} &= \frac{\mathrm{cov}(X,Y)}{\sqrt{D(X)\sqrt{D(Y)}}} = -0.5 \Rightarrow \mathrm{cov}(X,Y) = -1 \,, \\D(X+Y) &= D(X) + D(Y) + 2 \mathrm{cov}(X,Y) = 3 \,, \end{aligned}\text{根据切比雷夫不等式} P\{|X-E(X)| \geq \epsilon\} \leq \frac{D(X)}{\epsilon^2}，\text{有}\begin{aligned}P\Bigl\{|X+Y| \geq 6\Bigr\} &= P\{ |X+Y)-0| \geq 6 \} \\&\leq \frac{D(X+Y)}{6^2} = \frac{3}{36} = \frac{1}{12} \,.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&E(X)=-2,\;\;E(Y)=2,\\&D(X)=1,\;\;D(Y)=4,\;\;\rho_{X,Y}=0.25,\\&\therefore\;\;\;E(X+Y)=E(X)+E(Y)=0,\\&D(X+Y)=D(X)+D(Y)+2\rho_{X,Y}\sqrt{D(X)\sqrt{D(Y)}}=1+4+2\times 0.25\times 1\times 2=6,\\&\therefore\;\;P\{|X+Y|\geq 6\}\leq \frac{6}{6^2}=\frac{1}{6}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{设 } \lambda \text{ 为 } n \text{ 次试验中，事件 } A \text{ 发生的次数，则} & \quad X \sim b(n,0.75) \\ & \mu=0.75n, \ \sigma^2=0.75 \times 0.25n=0.1875n, \\ \text{所求为满足 } P\{0.74 < X/n < 0.76\} \geq 0.90 \text{ 的最小的 } n. \ P\{0.74 < X/n < 0.76\} \text{ 可改写为} \\ & \quad P\{0.74n < X < 0.76n\} = P\{-0.01n < X-0.75n < 0.01n\} = P\{|X-\mu|<0.01n\} \\ \text{在切比雪夫不等式中取 } \varepsilon=0.01n, \text{ 则} & \quad P\{0.74 < X/n < 0.76\} = P\{|X-\mu|<0.01n\} \geq 1-\sigma^2/(0.01n)^2 \\ & \quad=1-0.1875n/0.0001n^2=1-1875/n \\ \text{依题意，取 } n \text{ 使 } 1-1875/n \geq 0.9, \text{ 解得} & \quad n \geq 1875/(1-0.9)=18750, \\ \text{即 } n \text{ 取 } 18750 \text{ 时，可以使得在 } n \text{ 次独立重复试验中，事件 } A \text{ 出现的频率在 } 0.74 \sim 0.76 \text{ 之间的概率至少为 } 0.90. \end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{记}X_i\ (i=1,2,3,4) \text{为第}i \text{次掷骰子出现的点数，则}X_i\text{的分布为}\\ \begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|} \hline X_i & 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 & 5 & 6 \\ \hline p_i & 1/6 & 1/6 & 1/6 & 1/6 & 1/6 & 1/6 \\ \hline \end{array}\\ E(X_i)=\frac{1}{6}(1+2+3+4+5+6)=\frac{7}{2},\ E(X_i^2)=\frac{1}{6}(1+4+9+16+25+36)=\frac{91}{6},\\ D(X_i)=E(X_i^2)-[E(X_i)]^2=\frac{91}{6}-\frac{49}{4}=\frac{35}{12},\\ \text{一颗骰子连续掷}4\text{次，点数总和}\\ X=\sum_{i=1}^4X_i,\ E(X)=\sum_{i=1}^4E(X_i)=4\times\frac{7}{2}=14,\ D(X)=\sum_{i=1}^4D(X_i)=4\times\frac{35}{12}=\frac{35}{3},\\ \text{于是}\\ P\{10<X<18\}=P\{10-14<X-14<18-14\}\\ =\{|X-14|<4\}\geq1-\frac{1}{16}\times\frac{35}{3}\approx 0.271.\end{aligned}
